      Sets multiply
      
    
        
    
        A set is two or more cards of the same rarity in one pack. Boosted packs hold rare and legendary cards more often.
        
    
        Controls
        
    
        Autoplay opens up to 10 packs in a row and stops on a legendary. Turbo shortens the animation and never changes what a pack returns.
